svg.title: Two decode paths to the same GPU tensor
svg.desc: Four selected Sentinel-2 frames enter RAM. With CPU decode, OpenZL expands them before 524 kilobytes of decoded samples cross PCIe. With eligible GPU decode, 206 kilobytes of compressed bytes cross PCIe and PFOR or PivCo kernels expand them on the GPU. Both paths place samples in one PyTorch CUDA tensor through DLPack. GPU decode in auto mode needs a single-chunk PFOR or PivCo frame with one- or two-byte samples; other frames use CPU decode and still reach the GPU tensor.
svg.text: Other frames decode on CPU and reach the same tensor.
